card.name: Digits inside converted measurements
card.fires_on: A single digit, usually 6, 7 or 8, written inside parentheses right after a measurement, where it starts the converted value in another unit (inches, lb, mL/hour, miles, °C).

modes.label: Unit conversion in parentheses
modes.description: First digit of the converted amount after a metric or other unit and an opening parenthesis.
modes.example: are planted 16cm (<<6>>in) deep and most spring-flowering

modes.label: Digit after decimal or inside a number
modes.description: A digit within a number such as 7.5 or 0.6, in a dose or rate.
modes.example: up to 15 g (<<7>>.5 times the maximum recommended single dose
